item.title: Americans stuck in Middle East speak out amid strikes: 'Beyond scared'
item.description: Three dozen people, including a woman from Missouri, touring Israel together. A 17-year-old, her father, and their members of their North Carolina church. A husband and wife from Pittsburgh. They're all among the unknown number of Americans who found themselves stranded in the Middle East this weekend.

item.title: WATCH: Politics Today for the week of March 1, 2026
item.description: AMARILLO, Texas (KAMR/KCIT) — On March 1, the episode of Politics Today on KAMR Local 4 News featured Anchor Mari Ferrel reviewing multiple interviews from political candidates on the ballot for the March primaries. This week's episode holds interviews from several political candidates, including Ken King, Johnn Browning, Ronny Jackson, Chasity Wedgeworth, and Jamie Haynes.

item.title: High Plains History: Amarillo League of Women Voters
item.description: AMARILLO, Texas (KAMR/KCIT) — On this edition of High Plains History, we are joined by Claudia Stravato with the Amarillo League of Women Voters, as they recently celebrated 75 years. Stravato talks about the mission of LWV and how the LWV got started in Amarillo.
